name: 89128 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89128 (Las Vegas) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89128 (Las Vegas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
